title: Washington DC Private Walking Landmarks Tour
includes: Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private, exclusive tour with your own local guide. Traverse the most iconic landmarks of Washington, from the Lincoln Memorial to Capitol Hill. This experience combines American history, government institutions & monuments in one curated route.

Begin near the White House, where power & legacy meet. Walk through Lafayette Square & hear stories of decisions that shaped a nation. Continue along Pennsylvania Avenue, a symbolic route of American governance. At the National Archives, marvel at the nation's founding documents. Discover the political heart of the United States on this immersive walk. Ideal for first-time visitors, history enthusiasts & travelers seeking a deeper understanding of America’s capital city.

Please note: To comfortably cover multiple historic districts in one day, the tour may include brief rideshare transfers between stops. The program & attractions may vary based on booking date/time & crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
